title: Monthly Product Trajectory Cadence — Playbook for Executive Decision Signals
creator: Priya Nair
description: Purpose: create a concise, repeatable monthly playbook that product, eng, and design can use to prepare a 12–15 minute executive-facing trajectory briefing. The playbook standardizes what signals matter for the inference platform (latency/cost, capacity, model quality regressions, rollout health), what thresholds trigger an escalation or an investment ask, and what artifacts and owners are required by the pre-read. Scope: covers hosted API, Dedicated, and Private deployments; includes data sources (Console dashboards, rollout traces, cost-per-token dashboards, eval regressions), suggested visualizations, and a lightweight decision matrix for asks to execs. Outcome: reduce meeting prep time, increase clarity of choices, and shorten exec readouts while surfacing only actionable decisions and risks.
acceptance_criteria: A 2–3 page pre-read template exists and is stored in Confluence with clear fill-in guidance
A 12–15 minute slide template (cover + 3 signal slides + decision ask) tested in dry run with Eng/Infra/Design
Signal set defined with automated dashboard widgets: latency (p50/p95), cost/unit, capacity utilization, error/retry rate, eval regression delta
Decision matrix with thresholds for green/amber/red and explicit escalation steps is documented
Owners (PM/Eng/Design/Analytics) assigned for each signal and for maintaining pre-reads
At least one dry-run created and feedback incorporated into a v1 playbook
